deloitte-369605.text:
We are seeking a full stack software engineer to support the design, development, testing, and deployment of technology solutions for Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice. In this role, you will work with project teams to build and maintain applications, support delivery milestones, and contribute to client-focused outcomes. The ideal candidate brings foundational software engineering experience, strong technical discipline, and the ability to work across the software development life cycle.
Work you'll do
As a Project - Software Engineer II on the Government and Public Services team, you will be responsible for…
Supporting the design, development, testing, and deployment of software applications and system enhancements
Writing, debugging, and maintaining code using approved programming languages, frameworks, and development tools
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, document technical solutions, and support delivery activities
Participating in code reviews, unit testing, defect resolution, and release preparation activities
Monitoring application performance, troubleshooting issues, and supporting ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement efforts
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
The team
Deloitte’s Government and Public Services practice brings together people, ideas, technology, and outcomes to help clients make an impact. Serving federal, state, and local government clients, as well as public higher education institutions, the team helps organizations anticipate disruption, rethink what is possible, and advance their mission.
Qualifications
Required:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Information Systems, Health & Human Services, Social Sciences, Computer Science, or related field
2+ years of professional experience supporting business analysis, system implementation, technology modernization, or business process improvement initiatives
2+ years of experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements, user stories, business processes, workflows, and functional specifications
Experience supporting Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities including requirements management, design reviews, testing, defect triage, and implementation readiness
Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, or comparable business analysis tools
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements
Ability to work onsite full time in Des Moines, Iowa; a small relocation benefit is available if applicable
Ability to travel 0-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Preferred:
Experience supporting Integrated Eligibility, Human Services, Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, Child Welfare, Workforce, or other public sector health and human services programs
Experience working on state government technology modernization or large-scale system implementation initiatives
Experience documenting current-state and future-state business processes, use cases, business rules, and operational procedures
Experience with Agile methodologies, including Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar toolsets
Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), System Integration Testing (SIT), test case development, and defect management
Familiarity with eligibility determination, case management, benefits administration, or citizen-facing service delivery systems
Experience analyzing data, developing reports, and using findings to support business decision-making and process improvements
Experience supporting organizational change management, training, stakeholder engagement, or operational readiness activities
Knowledge of federal and state program regulations, policies, or compliance requirements related to health and human services programs
Preferred Technical Skills
Java / Spring Boot
REST APIs and microservices architecture
AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms
Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift
CI/CD and DevSecOps practices
Azure DevOps or GitHub Enterprise
Rules engines and workflow platforms
SQL and NoSQL databases
Automated testing frameworks and quality engineering practices
